ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Mireille... Uwah, what a crazy line! She looks too busy to see us...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Мирей... Ух, какая бешеная очередь! Она слишком занята, чтобы нас заметить...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Next. Ah, tax related? Take these documents to the tax office.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Следующий. А, по налогам? Отнесите эти документы в налоговую.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Next. Oh my, divorce? Fill this form, then. Next!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Следующий. О боже, развод? Тогда заполните эту форму. Следующий!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Wow, she's getting through them so quickly! The line is almost gone already!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Ого, она так быстро всех разбирает! Очередь уже почти кончилась!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Phew. Hey, girls! Is this about your Atelier Rank?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Уф. Эй, девочки! Это по поводу вашего ранга ателье?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Ah, no... We just want to talk to you, actually.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: А, нет... Мы просто хотели с тобой поговорить.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: That's more than welcome. Work has just calmed down a little, too.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Всегда пожалуйста. Работа как раз чуть поутихла.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: You handled that work so efficiently, Mireille!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Ты так ловко со всем справилась, Мирей!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Yes, well, I have confidence in my work. I've been doing this since I was small, after all!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Ну, в своей работе я уверена. В конце концов, занимаюсь этим с детства!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Ah, that confidence is so cool! You are wonderful, Mireille!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Ах, эта уверенность так круто! Ты прекрасна, Мирей!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: I know. Cheerful, honest, and so skillful! Just the kind of woman I want to grow up to be!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Точно. Весёлая, честная и такая умелая! Именно такой женщиной я хочу вырасти!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Oh... uhm...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Wow... Have we made you blush?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Ого... Мы тебя смутили до румянца?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Don't...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Не...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: What?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Что?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Please, don't praise me like that... I'm just not used to it.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Пожалуйста, не хвалите меня так... Я к этому просто не привыкла.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: I've been living in a world of adults since I was a child. Doing this job is just what I was raised to do.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: С детства живу в мире взрослых. Эта работа — то, к чему меня воспитали.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Hahaha, that's unexpected! You're so beautiful, well dressed, and smart!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха, неожиданно! Ты такая красивая, хорошо одетая и умная!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: I know! You have such smooth skin, too. Not to mention your wonderful handwriting!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Точно! И кожа такая гладкая. Не говоря уже о чудесном почерке!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Hold it, girls! Stop it. Stop it! I can't stop blushing!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Стойте, девочки! Хватит. Хватит! Я не могу перестать краснеть!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: What are they playing at now...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Во что они сейчас играют...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: Hehehe. I've been waiting for you, girls.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: M-Mireille? You have an extremely evil-looking look on your face!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: М-Мирей? У тебя на лице крайне злодейское выражение!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: Don't I just! I'm planning something really evil, that's why.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Ещё бы! Потому что я замышляю нечто действительно злое.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: I'm going to give you a special test now. If you can't do it, I'm dropping your rank!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Сейчас я устрою вам особое испытание. Не справитесь — понижу ранг!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: What?! Drop our rank?! Why would you do such a thing?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Что?! Понизить наш ранг?! Зачем тебе это?!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: Hah! This is payback for all those things you said to me before. I was so, so embarrassed!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Ха! Это месть за всё, что вы мне тогда наговорили. Мне было так, так стыдно!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: Tyrant! This is an abuse of power!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: What are you talking about? I'm just testing you, following the rules of the system!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: О чём ты? Я просто испытываю вас по правилам системы!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: Gah, this is hopeless! It's like hitting a puni with a stick!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Гах, бесполезно! Всё равно что бить пуни палкой!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: We can't outmaneuver her... Just give up. Come on then, Mireille. What is the test?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Нас не перехитрить... Сдаёмся. Ладно, Мирей. Какое испытание?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: I want you to make Zettel! The highest quality you can, or I won't accept it!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Хочу, чтобы вы сделали Зеттель! Максимального качества, иначе не приму!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: A tougher question than I expected... We have to do it! We don't want to lose our Rank!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Жёстче, чем я ждала... Придётся! Мы не хотим терять ранг!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Mireille, we made the Zettel. Is this good enough?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Мирей, мы сделали Зеттель. Этого достаточно?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Yes, you've passed! Although, to be quite honest, there's no test to pass!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Да, вы прошли! Хотя, честно говоря, никакого испытания и не было!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: ...What?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: ...Что?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Hehe! You mocked me, so I thought I'd get a little payback!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Хе-хе! Вы надо мной посмеялись — вот я и решила чуть отыграться!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: I wanted this Zettel for memo paper. It's just so comfortable to write on!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Зеттель мне нужен был для заметок. На нём так удобно писать!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: T-That's it?! All that worry for nothing?!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: И-и всё?! Все эти переживания зря?!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: I'm sorry. Here's your reward.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Простите. Вот ваша награда.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Hold on. All we did was make some Zettel... Are you sure you want to give us this much?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Погоди. Мы всего лишь сделали немного Зеттеля... Ты уверена, что хочешь дать нам столько?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Yes. As an apology for tricking you. Go ahead and take it.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Да. Как извинение за обман. Берите.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Thank you! If you just wanted memo paper, though, does it have to be Zettel?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Спасибо! Но если нужна просто бумага для заметок — обязательно именно Зеттель?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: I just use any scrap of paper I can get my hands on...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Я беру любой клочок, который попадётся под руку...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Ah, well, you know what they say. Nothing's better than Bettel!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Ах, ну, знаете, как говорят. Нет ничего лучше... Беттеля!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Huh...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Hah...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Ха...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: You see, nothing's better than...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Видите, нет ничего лучше...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: We heard you! We heard you, no need to say it again!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Мы слышали! Слышали, повторять не надо!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Good. Funny, wasn't it? Pretty witty on my part, I think you'll agree!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Хорошо. Забавно же было? По-моему, довольно остроумно с моей стороны!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Hah. You're so cool the rest of the time, Mireille, but sometimes you just...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Ха. В остальное время ты такая крутая, Мирей, но иногда ты просто...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: We should write this one on an official notice. It's so good everyone in the city should know it!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Надо вывесить это в официальном объявлении. Так хорошо, что весь город должен знать!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Uh... Please don't...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Э-э... Пожалуйста, не надо...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: System
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: 1800 Coll received.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Получено 1800 колл.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: Say, twins. I've got something to ask you.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Слушайте, близнецы. Хочу вас кое о чём спросить.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Как вы думаете, меня держат под колпаком?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: Uwah, in perfect unison, too! I've been feeling it, but I guess you're right.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Ух, ещё и хором! Я это чувствовала, но, похоже, вы правы.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: It's too extreme, isn't it? Not being allowed to leave the castle until I'm grown!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Это же перебор, да? Не выпускать из замка, пока не вырасту!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: Hahaha. I guess there's no helping that?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Ха-ха-ха. Ну, тут уже ничего не поделаешь?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: Maybe, but that's a bit too clean and easy for me... I'm in line for the throne, after all.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Может, и так, но для меня это слишком гладко и просто... Всё-таки я в очереди на трон.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: In order to learn more about the world, I'm thinking of going to do a homestay somewhere.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Чтобы узнать мир получше, думаю съездить куда-нибудь на проживание в семье.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: Just a regular household. I'll wear an apron and call the owner "Sir", that kind of thing!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: В обычный дом. Надену фартук и буду звать хозяина «сэр» — что-то в этом роде!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: Hold it, Lydie! What was that noise for?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Стойте, Лиди! Это ещё что за звук?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: That's not a "homestay"! I don't know what that is!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Это не «проживание в семье»! Я даже не знаю, что это такое!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: R-Really? Then I think I have to change my plans.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: П-правда? Тогда, кажется, придётся менять планы.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: It looks like I'm more sheltered than I thought... I guess I shouldn't tease him so much anymore.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Похоже, меня держат под колпаком сильнее, чем я думала... Наверное, не стоит его больше так дразнить.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Hehe! Hehehe!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Хе-хе! Хе-хе-хе!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: That's scary! That laugh is real scary, Mireille!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Страшно! Этот смех реально жуткий, Мирей!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Uwah, I'm going to have nightmares about that. You need to sleep with me tonight, Lydie...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Ух, мне теперь кошмары будут сниться. Сегодня ночуешь со мной, Лиди...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: I-It was that bad? Sorry!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Т-так плохо? Простите!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: You were watching those kids, right? Not thinking about eating them, are you?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Ты за этими детьми наблюдала, да? Не думаешь их съесть?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Ah! If I was going to eat anyone, I'd start with you two delicious morsels!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Ах! Если уж кого и есть — начну с вас, двух аппетитных кусочков!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Uwah!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Ух!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: I'm joking. I was just taking a break from work. Watching kids play is very calming, right?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Шучу. Просто отдыхала от работы. Смотреть, как играют дети, очень успокаивает, правда?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Huh... I've not seen this side of you before, Mireille.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Ха... Я раньше не видела тебя с такой стороны, Мирей.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Seeing them play so innocently, it gives me the energy to keep on going.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Смотреть, как они так невинно играют, даёт мне силы идти дальше.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: To make a great kingdom, that everyone will be proud to live in once they grow up.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Чтобы построить великое королевство, которым каждый будет гордиться, когда вырастет.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Haha, most impressive. Thinking about the future even when you're taking a break from work!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Ха-ха, впечатляет. Даже на перерыве думаешь о будущем!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: H-Hold on! I told you to stop praising me!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: С-стойте! Я же просила не хвалить меня!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Hahaha! Hey, Mireille. We're still kids ourselves, right?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Эй, Мирей. Мы сами ещё дети, да?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: So how about you make the rank tests a bit easier? Just for us?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Так может, сделаешь испытания на ранг чуть проще? Только для нас?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Very well, then. I'll make them as hard as I possibly can, just for that!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Тогда ладно. Сделаю их настолько сложными, насколько смогу — как раз за это!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: A real sweet and naive child would never ask such a thing! You've just proven your maturity!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Настоящий милый наивный ребёнок такого бы не попросил! Вы только что доказали свою зрелость!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Gah! Forget I said anything! Keep things the same, things are fine as they are!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Гах! Забудь, что я сказала! Оставь всё как есть, всё и так нормально!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Haha, then don't try to get tricky! Kids should be honest and innocent.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Ха-ха, тогда не хитрите! Дети должны быть честными и непосредственными.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: There will be plenty of time for tricks once you are all grown up, believe me.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Для хитростей ещё будет время, когда вырастете, поверьте.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: Ah, twins! Perfect timing! I just found something really great in this draw!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Ах, близнецы! Как раз вовремя! Только что нашла в этом ящике кое-что замечательное!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: A certificate of marriage? For Mathias and... you!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Свидетельство о браке? Для Матиаса и... тебя!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: That's right! Mathias made this when we were kids!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Верно! Матиас сделал это, когда мы были детьми!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: You said something great, didn't you?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: You know what he's like now, of course, but back then he was so cute!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Какой он сейчас — вы знаете, но тогда он был таким милым!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: Kind, smart, and obedient. The perfect little brother. Ah, this takes me back!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Добрый, умный и послушный. Идеальный младший брат. Ах, как же давно это было!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: I can't really picture Mathias like that... Uwah, I don't even want to try!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Я вообще не могу представить Матиаса таким... Ух, даже пробовать не хочу!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: He said he wanted to make me happy, but of course as brother and sister we can't really get married!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Он сказал, что хочет сделать меня счастливой, но брат и сестра, конечно, пожениться не могут!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: So he promised that he'd become a fine king, and make all people happy, rather than just me.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Поэтому пообещал стать прекрасным королём и сделать счастливыми всех, а не только меня.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: I'm still hoping he's up to the challenge, to be honest.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Честно говоря, я всё ещё надеюсь, что он справится.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: Ah, but don't tell him about this. He'll get all carried away again if he hears this.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Ах, только не говорите ему. Он опять зазнается, если услышит.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: Hahaha, that's true. It will just be our secret, then!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Ха-ха-ха, это правда. Тогда это будет наш секрет!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: Good. I'll put this back in the desk. Until the day he finally keeps his promise.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Хорошо. Положу обратно в стол. До дня, когда он наконец сдержит обещание.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: Say, girls. Be honest. What do you think of Mathias?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Скажите, девочки. Честно. Что вы думаете о Матиасе?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: Hmm. I mean, that's not an easy question to answer... He's not a bad person, but a bit flaky?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Хм. Не самый простой вопрос... Он неплохой человек, но немного ветреный?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: Hahaha, I see where you are coming from... He's funny, though, so I like him.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Ха-ха-ха, понимаю, откуда ты... Но он забавный, так что он мне нравится.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: Funny and flaky? It sounds like you think he's a pretty poor example of a man?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Забавный и ветреный? Похоже, вы считаете его довольно жалким образцом мужчины?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: You don't hold back, do you... Although I guess he isn't all that reliable...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Вы не церемонитесь... Хотя он и правда не самый надёжный...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: At his core, though, Mathias is a serious fellow. He's always thinking about our kingdom first.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Но в основе Матиас серьёзный. Он всегда думает о королевстве в первую очередь.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: But he's also a little bit of a coward, a trait not easily explained away... I don't know how it happened.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Но он ещё и немного трус — эту черту не так просто объяснить... Не знаю, как так вышло.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: There is that side to him... I wonder if there's any way to remedy it?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Да, есть в нём такое... Интересно, можно ли это как-то исправить?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: A remedy? Hmm, you know what, I've got an idea. I think I'll need your help with it, though.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Исправить? Хм, знаете что — у меня есть идея. Хотя, кажется, без вашей помощи не обойтись.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: What? Our help? To do what?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: A secret, for now. You can look forward to it, though!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Пока секрет. Но можете с нетерпением ждать!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: Maybe not. That smile is telling me there's nothing to look forward to for us!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Может, и не стоит. Эта улыбка говорит, что ждать нам нечего хорошего!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: Hahaha! We'd better be ready for anything!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Лучше быть готовыми ко всему!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Twins, I'm sorry!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Близнецы, простите!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Ah, hold on! Mireille? What's wrong?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Ах, погоди! Мирей? В чём дело?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: I need to apologize about the Royal Trial... That was meant to light a fire under Mathias...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Мне нужно извиниться за Королевское испытание... Оно должно было подстегнуть Матиаса...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Seeing you two fight, he was meant to realize that someone else may take the throne from him, if he's not careful.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Увидев, как вы двое сражаетесь, он должен был понять: если не будет осторожен, трон могут забрать другие.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: We pretty much guessed that much. But why are you apologizing?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Мы примерно так и догадались. Но почему ты извиняешься?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: I know you defeated the guardian, but actually the rules state that it has to be fought alone.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Знаю, вы победили стража, но по правилам с ним нужно сражаться в одиночку.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: So you haven't actually earned the right to take the throne.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Так что права на трон вы на самом деле не заслужили.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: I tricked you, used you, and then gave you false hope! I'm really sorry, girls.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Я вас обманула, использовала и дала ложную надежду! Мне очень жаль, девочки.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Hahaha, don't worry about it. All that power, those robes, it would be too much for us anyway.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Ха-ха-ха, не переживай. Вся эта власть, эти мантии — нам всё равно было бы слишком.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Lydie is right. We can't rule. The one's who were born to become rulers should do it, after all.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Лиди права. Мы не можем править. Это должны делать те, кто рождён править.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: So, we're not that bothered about it. In fact, we're not bothered at all!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Так что нас это не особо волнует. На самом деле — совсем не волнует!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Twins! At least let me give you this. In thanks for your cooperation.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Близнецы! Хотя бы позвольте дать вам это. В благодарность за сотрудничество.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Uwah, thank you! I think we can use that!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Ух, спасибо! Думаю, нам это пригодится!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Good. You two really are something else, though, aren't you? Defeating that guardian like that!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Хорошо. Но вы двое и правда нечто... Вот так победить стража!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: That's right. There's nothing we can't do when we're together!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Верно. Вместе нам всё по плечу!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Hehe, nothing at all? I almost wish I'd got to see you both take the throne, then!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Хе-хе, совсем всё? Тогда мне почти хотелось бы увидеть, как вы обе взойдёте на трон!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Hold on! I don't think that "nothing" includes ruling a nation! Sorry!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Стоп! Не думаю, что «всё» включает правление страной! Извини!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Promise with Mom Number 1! "Don't give up before you even try!" Something like that, right?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Обещание маме номер один! «Не сдавайся, даже не попробовав!» Что-то в этом роде, да?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: That's what you always say, right? So nothing is impossible for you in this world.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Вы же всегда так говорите? Значит, для вас в этом мире нет ничего невозможного.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Hehehe, you might be right! Becoming queens would let us live in the lap of luxury!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Хе-хе-хе, может, ты и права! Стать королевами — и жить в роскоши!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Hold it, Sue! Don't get distracted. We have to become the greatest alchemists in the kingdom!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Стой, Сью! Не отвлекайся. Нам нужно стать величайшими алхимиками королевства!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Bah, this all because Mathias won't just bite the bullet and become king! Mathias, you flake!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Ба, всё из-за того, что Матиас не стиснет зубы и не станет королём! Матиас, ты тряпка!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: System
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: <CLEG>Smaragd<CLNR>, <CLEG>Ruby<CLNR>, <CLEG>Sapphire<CLNR> received.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Получены <CLEG>Смарагд<CLNR>, <CLEG>Рубин<CLNR>, <CLEG>Сапфир<CLNR>.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..original: La la la! Work is going so smoothly today!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..translation: Ла-ла-ла! Сегодня работа идёт так гладко!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..original: Hahaha, you seem in a good mood, Mireille. Is that because of Mathias?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха, у тебя хорошее настроение, Мирей. Из-за Матиаса?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..original: That's right. He's finally made the decision to become the king.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..translation: Верно. Он наконец решил стать королём.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..original: I've been working hard to make sure Mathias becomes a good king, but I'm almost done now.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..translation: Я столько трудилась, чтобы Матиас стал хорошим королём, и вот я почти закончила.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..original: He'll be on the throne before you know it!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..translation: Он окажется на троне, прежде чем оглянешься!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..original: Yeah. I'm so relieved. I've done my duty as his sister! Thank goodness for that.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..translation: Ага. Мне так спокойно. Я выполнила долг сестры! Слава богу.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..original: Now he's finally getting serious, he'll surely make a fine ruler. Which means I can finally...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..translation: Раз он наконец взялся серьёзно — из него выйдет прекрасный правитель. А значит, я наконец смогу...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Tell me, twins. Is a golden puni statue required for living on your own?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Скажите, близнецы. Золотая статуя пуни обязательна для самостоятельной жизни?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Why would it be?! What are you planning on using it for?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: С чего бы?! Для чего ты её собираешься использовать?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Hahaha, don't ask me. It was a gift so I'm just asking.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха, не спрашивайте. Это подарок, вот я и спрашиваю.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Well, if you don't have a use for it you don't need... hold on, living on your own? Who?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Ну, если она тебе не нужна — не нужна... погоди, самостоятельная жизнь? Кто?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Hahaha, who do you think? Me, of course.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха, а как вы думаете? Я, конечно.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: M-Mireille! Living alone? C-Can you really do that?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: М-Мирей! Жить одной? Т-ты правда сможешь?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Yes! Of course I can! Just who do you think I am?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Да! Конечно смогу! Как вы думаете, кто я такая?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: H-Huh. But why? Why now?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: А-а. Но почему? Почему сейчас?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: I'm also in line for the throne, remember? But Mathias is the one who will become the king.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Я тоже в очереди на трон, помните? Но королём станет Матиас.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: It would get tricky if I was hanging around, so after he's crowned I'm leaving the castle.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Будет неловко, если я буду рядом, так что после коронации я покину замок.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: So that's why... Sorry, Mireille, for ever thinking that you couldn't do it!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Так вот почему... Прости, Мирей, что когда-то думала, будто ты не справишься!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Hah! Just you have a look at this, then! Proof that I can handle living alone!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Ха! Тогда взгляните на это! Доказательство, что я справлюсь с жизнью одной!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: That's a pretty long list... Just what is this?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Довольно длинный список... Что это?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: That's everything you need to live alone! The bare minimum! You'll find it all correct and proper.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Всё необходимое для жизни одной! Самый минимум! Всё правильно и как положено.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: A crystal shield? Cross that off. And a crystal ball, too? What for? Cross that off.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Хрустальный щит? Вычёркиваем. И хрустальный шар? Зачем? Вычёркиваем.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Twenty pairs of shoes? Cross! Knives, sure, but ten of them? Cross, cross!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Двадцать пар обуви? Крест! Ножи — ладно, но десять? Крест, крест!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: H-Hold on! My list is getting mutilated!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: С-стойте! Мой список калечат!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: That's odd... You've cut it down to a fraction of what I started with.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Странно... Вы сократили его до малой доли того, с чего я начинала.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: That's right. There was far too much waste on there to start with.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Верно. С самого начала там было слишком много лишнего.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: And lots of things missing, too. You need cutlery, don't you? Dishes?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: И многого не хватает. Тебе нужны столовые приборы, да? Посуда?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Dishes, right! Hey, I know, could you make some hard to break ones with alchemy?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Посуда, точно! Эй, а можете алхимией сделать такую, которую трудно разбить?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: I think I'll probably break regular ones a bit too quickly.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Обычную я, кажется, слишком быстро переломаю.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Yes, okay. To celebrate you moving out, we'll bring you a lovely set of dishes!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Да, хорошо. В честь твоего переезда принесём прекрасный набор посуды!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Thank you! Just a little gold leaf will be fine, and for the pattern...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Спасибо! Достаточно чуть сусального золота, а узор...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: They are going to be plain sturdy dishes, I'm afraid. Please keep that in mind.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Боюсь, это будет простая прочная посуда. Имейте это в виду.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: Mireille, here are your hard to break dishes.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: Wow, they're lovely! Living on my own is going to be so much fun, I know it!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Ого, какая красивая! Жить одной будет так весело, я знаю!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: But what's with you two? You seem a bit down?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Но что с вами двумя? Выглядите немного расстроенными?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: We're just a bit sad that you're going to be leaving the castle, that's all.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Нам просто чуть грустно, что ты уходишь из замка, вот и всё.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: Hahaha, that's what you've been thinking about? I'm not a permanent fixture, after all!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Ха-ха-ха, вот о чём вы думали? Я же не вечная статуя здесь!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: Once I'm living alone, I also plan to rely heavily on both of you.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Когда буду жить одна, тоже сильно на вас обеих рассчитывать.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: You'll still see me, even if I'm not around here. So there's no need to be sad! Not at all!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Вы всё равно будете меня видеть, даже если меня здесь не будет. Так что грустить нечего! Совсем!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: Hey, that's right! In fact, we might see more of you than we do now!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Эй, правда! Может, мы даже будем видеться чаще, чем сейчас!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: That's right! You'll be sick of my face before long, I promise you!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Верно! Скоро вам надоест моё лицо, обещаю!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: Okay! I can't wait! You're welcome at our atelier any time!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Ладно! Не терпится! В нашем ателье тебе всегда рады!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: Hehe! I need to get back to my preparations, anyway. There isn't long until the coronation.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Хе-хе! Впрочем, мне пора к приготовлениям. До коронации осталось немного.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Right, that's another job done! Next...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Так, ещё одно дело сделано! Дальше...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Mireille, hello! You're as busy as ever!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Мирей, привет! Ты по-прежнему занята!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: That goes without saying! I'm the ruler in the shadows now, which means work work work!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Само собой! Теперь я теневая правительница — значит работа, работа, работа!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Our king needs a lot of support, after all. I'm going to be working the rest of my life!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Нашему королю нужна большая поддержка. Я буду работать всю оставшуюся жизнь!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Hahaha! You seem pretty happy about it, though...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Хотя ты, кажется, этому очень рада...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: When he said he needed my help, to be honest, I was overjoyed.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Когда он сказал, что ему нужна моя помощь, честно говоря, я была вне себя от радости.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: And impressed, too. I've never considered that we might rule the kingdom together.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: И впечатлена тоже. Никогда не думала, что мы можем править королевством вместе.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Mathias has proved he can think outside the box. He's going to make a great king, you'll see.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Матиас доказал, что умеет мыслить нестандартно. Из него выйдет великий король, вот увидите.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: So I'm going to support him fully from behind! He's my brother, after all!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Так что я полностью поддержу его из тени! Всё-таки он мой брат!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Hehe... With both of you working on this, I'm sure you'll make an amazing kingdom!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Хе-хе... Если вы оба за это возьмётесь, уверена — получится потрясающее королевство!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: You can count on it! I'll do everything I can as the shadow ruler!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Можете рассчитывать! Как теневая правительница я сделаю всё, что смогу!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: This will be a country where every child can chase their dreams, just like you two!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Это будет страна, где каждый ребёнок сможет гнаться за мечтой — как вы двое!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Keep up the good work, then, Mireille! Ah, you're so cool, so beautiful!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Тогда продолжай в том же духе, Мирей! Ах, ты такая крутая, такая красивая!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: We're right behind you too, Mireille! Ah, you're so talented, so elegant!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Мы тоже за тобой, Мирей! Ах, ты такая талантливая, такая элегантная!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Hey! Quit it! Stop that, twins!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Эй! Хватит! Прекратите, близнецы!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Together
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Hahaha!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: System
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Hahaha!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Enough! You can't go around picking on adults!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Хватит! Нельзя вот так придираться к взрослым!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Hehehe, sorry about that! We'll see you again soon, Mireille!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Хе-хе-хе, прости! Скоро увидимся, Мирей!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: See you! Bye-bye!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Увидимся! Пока-пока!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Curse their cuteness! I can't be angry after seeing two lovely smiles like that.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Будь проклята их милота! Не могу злиться, увидев две такие прелестные улыбки.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: It's our job to protect those smiles, too. Isn't that right, Mathias?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Наша задача — защищать и эти улыбки. Правда, Матиас?
